## Episode Thesis

The episode is a macro discussion of the Fed's decision to hold rates, a 10-2 vote in which Lisa Cook and one other member wanted a hike. Experts read Chair Warsh's press conference as slightly dovish: he stressed tighter financial conditions over inflation, and he announced fewer rate meetings from next year. The second half covers the US midterm elections, where Polymarket gives Democrats a 67% chance of taking the Senate, and what a divided Congress would mean for fiscal policy and markets. No individual stocks are discussed, so no actionable signals were extracted.
